scope: Corrected-source integrated GNU regression and 26 planned behavioral negative executions over 25 production variants; not complete packet qualification.
parser_and_derivation_inputs: All five transitive parser input hashes are pinned in mutations-v2 and checked before import. Only pure roster parsers are reused; no R119 runner, collector or parent-bound acceptance function is invoked.
baseline_requirement: Normal zero exit, unchanged corrected map, closed child and empty owned group, valid raw clocks, and exact accepted R119 executable/test roster plus 23 declared KFD additions: 2818 passed, 5 ignored, 48 libtest harnesses and one unchanged harnessless CSV benchmark. KFD has 1172 passing tests; runtime has 733.
execution_policy: Primary applies one declared mutation using apply_patch after compiler/test closure, executes its exact behavioral test with the GNU baseline as predecessor, checks the intended final assertion and closed process group, restores only its owned mutation using apply_patch, then verifies all corrected-source identities before the next case. The cold-mode and content cases may execute first.
restoration_scope: The checker restored mode proves source equality only. Primary must separately observe child/process-group closure before restoration. Unknown or live child state never permits source edits.

interrupted_history.classification: Intentional SIGTERM for known test-oracle gaps; null child exit code, wrapper 127, not timed out, not a spawn failure or passing qualification.

review: Two bounded read-only reviews found no descriptor/checker defects before execution. This is static review, not a claim that planned tests passed.
rejected_history: Preserve compile failures, unexpected assertions, timeouts and failed restorations. Never overwrite a run artifact or executed helper; use a new version when correcting an executed helper.
